# nself remove

<!-- BEGIN PROSE:summary -->
> Remove an installed plugin or bundle.

**Plugin data.** In v1.4 mode a plugin remove drops the plugin's schema/tables unless `--keep-data`, and warns when it does so by default. From v1.5 (`NSELF_V15=1`) a plugin remove keeps the data, as a bundle remove does; `--delete-data` drops it and needs `--yes` or a `y` answer on a terminal, otherwise it stops with E403 (exit 4) and removes nothing. `--force` past E133 (a plugin a bundle still references) does not change this. See [[Compat-V15]].
<!-- END PROSE:summary -->

## Synopsis

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED:synopsis -->
<!-- GENERATED BY tools/wikigen — DO NOT HAND EDIT -->
```
nself remove <name> [flags]
```
<!-- END GENERATED:synopsis -->

**Alias:** `nself rm`

## Description

<!-- BEGIN PROSE:description -->
Remove an installed plugin or bundle by name.

This is the short form of `nself plugin remove`. As with install, a bundle
name removes the whole bundle.

Use `nself remove waf --plan` to preview regeneration and container changes
without removing plugin files, data or running containers. The preview uses a
temporary copy of the installed plugin tree and honors reverse dependencies
(or `--force`). With `--json`, `dry_run` is true and `plan` contains the change plan.
Plans currently support individual registry plugins; bundles and builtin toggles
are refused. `--plan` cannot be combined with `--delete-data` or `--dry-run`.
<!-- END PROSE:description -->

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED:flags -->
<!-- GENERATED BY tools/wikigen — DO NOT HAND EDIT -->
| Name | Shorthand | Type | Default | Env | Escalates to | JSON override | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--delete-data` |  | `bool` | `false` |  |  |  | Delete plugin data (schema/tables). A bundle remove asks for confirmation (or pass --yes); a plugin remove never asks and drops data unless --keep-data |
| `--dry-run` |  | `bool` | `false` |  |  |  | Print the planned actions without removing |
| `--force` |  | `bool` | `false` |  |  |  | Remove even if other plugins depend on this one |
| `--keep-data` |  | `bool` | `false` |  |  |  | Preserve database data on remove |
| `--plan` |  | `bool` | `false` |  |  |  | Show regeneration without removing plugins or data |
| `--yes` |  | `bool` | `false` |  |  |  | Skip confirmation prompts |
| `--help` | `-h` | `bool` | `false` | | | | Show help |
